verdict.rationale: BigCommerce's first-party docs describe B2B Edition for wholesale buyers, with company accounts, quotes, and custom pricing. A dedicated B2B solution page backs this up. However, the evidence is a single thin line, and several parts of the story are not shown. Missing for 10: documented volume/tiered pricing, net-terms invoicing, explicit confirmation that B2B runs alongside DTC on the same store, in-depth docs on customer-specific price lists, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a merchant, I can sell B2B and wholesale — customer-specific price lists, volume pricing, quotes or net-terms invoicing — alongside DTC
